title: Bind complex node costs to actual compact widths and local suspension
body:
## Summary

```text
actual PR2250 monomial lowering
  -> ordinary width (f-1)G, fixed all-column schedule
  -> long-record guard/repair absorption
  -> conditional O(v e^(1-a2) polylog p) node invoice
```

Separates COMPLEX.md's missing reached-layout and local-suspension contracts from its child-volume hypothesis. An admitted rank-1-path countermodel shows why geometric O(V_root) parked space does not justify a local node time bound when the caller traverses buried history. The actual uniform mixed request/continuation adapter remains open; no new kappa.

## Evidence

- **Before:** COMPLEX.md asserts serialization and geometric parked volumes; the actual adapter simulator rewinds/erases its whole local tape and does not supply an ancestor-relative complex-node dispatcher.
- **After:** Source-authenticated actual lowering traces verify early/late all-column ordinary widths and f=1's no-call branch. Eighteen guard cases and a complete-row gather/park/return/replace fixture pass; dirty ancestor extents 16, 257 and 4096 each cost 5604 payload primitives. Seven controls reject width, layout, spectator, return, historical-rewind and erasure failures.
- Registered metadata/pin validation and normal/`-O` replay pass locally in 0.20 s and 0.42 s. `VALIDATION.json` records exact commands and environment. The request recorder does not execute monomial payloads, and the transport fixture uses a supplied completed child result. No full-node, native, ordinary, Gamma-cover or stopped-root replay ran.
- Committed bytes/source history and official export/check pass for 23 files; the extracted export's direct checker also passes normally and under `-O` without Git.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated package; frozen predecessors and the selected frontier remain unchanged. This is a scoped conditional invoice and exact interface handoff, not physical N(i) acceptance or a multiplication theorem. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor credit and source notices are retained.
